summary: The character entry distinguishes an exemplary pattern or model, a delimited frame, and broad distribution. The standalone han noun means an exemplar. The nori entry jointly lists several spellings and separately covers binding norms, exemplary models, human moral principles, Buddhist teachings or precepts, a reference length or scale, dimensions, construction slopes, and distance. It does not make every spelling idiomatic in every listed use.

quotes.text: 基準となる一定の型。手本。
